title: HabitPact
summary: A behavioral-accountability mobile app that helps people follow through on their goals by attaching real consequences — financial, social, and device-based — to the commitments they make.
problem: Most habit apps track what you do. HabitPact adds a reason to actually do it. Users set a goal (fitness, studying, productivity), commit to it, and stake something on follow-through — a financial penalty, an accountability partner who gets notified, or a device restriction that limits distractions until the commitment is met. The bet: consequences move behavior in a way streak counters alone don't.
approach: Owned the product end to end — vision, user journeys, spec, and roadmap — from whiteboard concept to a working prototype. Built cross-platform in Flutter, using AI-assisted development (Claude, ChatGPT) across requirements, prototyping, and debugging to ship quickly. Feature set was prioritized against market and competitive research of habit-tracking and commitment-device tools.
outcome: Working prototype: demoable and beta-ready. Built solo, 0-to-1, from whiteboard to a shippable cross-platform app.
